name: adw
description: The spec, plan, run pipeline packaged as the adw plugin. Pin at install: claude plugin marketplace add ryanmat/adw@<tag>.

plugins.name: adw
plugins.description: /adw:spec, /adw:plan-tdd, /adw:next (attended and hold-only unattended), the plan-grammar and auto-run scripts with the plan-time step size estimate, the PreToolUse guard hook, the Stop hook, the opt-in ruling-log and ruling-recall hooks, the next-implementer and next-reviewer run agents, the spec-miner agent that mines a brownfield codebase into the baseline spec.md ahead of /adw:plan-tdd, and the markdown deliverables skill.
